findings.claim: The change deletes the Str8 branch of the string-header writer. Strings of 32-255 UTF-8 bytes would then be written with a 3-byte Str16 header (0xDA) instead of the 2-byte Str8 header (0xD9). That changes the serialized bytes of every such string. The requirement is about the analyzer under SuppressSourceGeneration and asks for no serializer runtime change, so this is an unrelated wire-format change.

findings.claim: None of the type-collector hunks refer to SuppressSourceGeneration. They only add `continue` after DoNotMixStringAndIntKeys and ContainsKey guards against duplicate keys. The README promises that such types still get MsgPack003/004/005/012/015, but the shown code does not show that this happens, so the core requirement may be unmet.
